probe_detail.name: Caption reframes what the drawing is a picture of
Line is assigned to the character it is least expected from
Explicitly names an object visible in the drawing
Punctuated as a completed sentence of direct speech

final.name: Time-bound political topicality
final.audit_justification: It measures topical subject matter and contemporaneity without evaluating the caption's effectiveness.

final.name: Perspective Ventriloquism
final.audit_justification: A productive mismatch between speaker perspective and visual is substantive evidence of comic construction.

final.name: Familiar-phrase transformation
final.audit_justification: Precisely transforming a familiar phrase to fit the image evaluates substantive wordplay and fit.

final.name: Concise completeness
final.audit_justification: Despite mentioning compactness, it primarily evaluates completeness, self-containment, and delivery of the joke.

final.name: Direct pun or wordplay reliance
final.audit_justification: It records reliance on a pun as a technique without judging whether the resulting caption is good.
final.upstream_parent: author's practice in the caption format

final.name: Direct Idiom Literalization
final.audit_justification: It measures use of literalized idioms as a form or trope rather than evaluating execution.

final.name: Generic conversational sitcom quip
final.audit_justification: Generic sitcom style is a boilerplate or stylistic marker, not intrinsic caption quality.

final.name: Stakes Incongruity
final.audit_justification: A productive mismatch between ordinary and existential stakes is substantive comic craft.

final.name: Idiom-to-Visual Subversion
final.audit_justification: It evaluates how brilliantly an idiom is integrated with the exact visual scenario.

final.name: Conceptual Recontextualization
final.audit_justification: Redefining visible objects as a different concept is a substantive recontextualization of the cartoon.

final.name: Era-coded idiom
final.audit_justification: Period-coded language is a temporal and cultural style marker rather than evidence of caption quality.
final.upstream_parent: position in the long-running contest series

final.name: Strictly Lowercase Orthography
final.audit_justification: Capitalization practice is orthographic formatting unrelated to the caption's substance.
final.upstream_parent: house style of the contest magazine

final.name: Generic caption closure
final.audit_justification: It identifies generic template-like joke structure while explicitly excluding judgment of quality.

final.name: Extreme Brevity Word-Count
final.audit_justification: Word count and fragment length are verbosity or formatting properties, not intrinsic quality.

final.name: Cultural-frame mapping
final.audit_justification: Mapping the image coherently onto a broader cultural or social frame evaluates substantive interpretation.

final.name: Dual-Code Wordplay Activation
final.audit_justification: A necessary interaction between literal and figurative meanings is substantive layered wordplay.

final.name: Surprise reinterpretation
final.audit_justification: A sharp, understandable second reading is direct evidence of effective joke construction.

final.name: Consensus-angle pun
final.audit_justification: It measures conventional visual associations without evaluating whether the caption develops them well.

final.name: Pop-Culture Prop Reliance Penalty
final.audit_justification: Dependence on outside recognition affects the caption's self-containedness and accessibility as a contest entry.

final.name: List-normalization typography
final.audit_justification: Raw-entry and transcription conventions are production or formatting fingerprints, not caption substance.

final.name: Socially Plausible Impossible Character
final.audit_justification: Giving an impossible participant a coherent social role and motive evaluates internal comic plausibility.

final.name: Deadpan Tone Contrast
final.audit_justification: Effective deadpan contrast with the visual's chaos is a substantive tonal choice that can strengthen the joke.

final.name: Layered Double Entendre
final.audit_justification: A precisely fitting double meaning evaluates substantive layered interpretation of the image.

final.name: Character-voiced perspective
final.audit_justification: A convincing character voice or viewpoint is substantive evidence that the caption fits the depicted figures.

final.name: Exact pun construction
final.audit_justification: Precision, recognizability, and tight image linkage evaluate the execution of the pun itself.
